mapper.sql: e . id , e.user_id userId,e.user_name userName,e.user_avatar userAvatar, e.evaluator_id evaluatorId, e.evaluator_name evaluatorName, e.evaluator_avatar evaluatorAvatar, e.status, e.ctime, e.score, e.tag, e.type, e.apply_id applyId
mapper.select:
select
, count(1) count , count(if(l.user_id = #{loginUserId},1,0)) hasLike from corgi_evaluation e left join corgi_evaluation_like l on l.evaluation_id = e.id where e.user_id = #{userId} and e.status != 'deleted' and l.status = '1' group by e.id order by e.id desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select
, count(1) count , count(if(l.user_id = #{loginUserId},1,0)) hasLike from corgi_evaluation e left join corgi_evaluation_like l on l.evaluation_id = e.id where e.user_id = #{userId} and e.status != 'deleted' and l.status = '1' group by e.id order by count desc limit #{size}

select a.apply_user_id applyUserId, a.approval_user_id approvalUserId, a.type from corgi_date_apply a where a.status = 'agree' and (a.approval_user_id = #{userId} or a.apply_user_id = #{userId}) and not exists( select 1 from corgi_evaluation where evaluator_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' and apply_id = a.id)
select sum(score) / count(score) from corgi_evaluation where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' order by id desc limit 30
select score from corgi_evaluation where tag = #{tag} and score is not null order by id desc limit 1
